prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) was helpful, while placing sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing showed no clear effect. Multi-device account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%, overpredicted), but pet sync verification hints and pet restoration callouts showed no clear effect.
Path clarity headline updates were helpful (+5.9%, underpredicted), whereas copy simplification, value refreshes, clear outcome headlines, value focus refreshes, time expectation banners, and showcase layouts showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted), background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted), and desktop visibility status check wait info (+4.7%, underpredicted) were helpful, but 3D progress trackers, progress details, animation progress status, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.
Photo quality guides with companion preview were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted), while compact grid layouts (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), custom photo guidelines banners (-5.0%), and mascot stamp redesigns (-24.1%) made results worse; split upload assistants showed no clear effect.
System tray location notification tips were helpful (+3.8%, overpredicted), whereas first interaction tips made results worse (-6.5%), and sound notifications, spawn alerts, mascot welcome stages, interaction badges, tray controls tips, and docking hints showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Upload Companion Preview Layout: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a side-by-side split layout featuring a real-time photo quality preview component. (why: Adoption conversion drop to 63.0% with long mean time (1017s) and support tickets reporting custom pet generation failures.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Direct Controls Guide: Add a new interactive onboarding summary screen immediately after home intro to explain desktop controls and system tray toggles. (why: Multiple support complaints regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split Story Visual Showcase Redesign: Redesign the opening story screen into a split layout combining animated mascot visuals with concise narrative text. (why: Choose path screen has high drop-off (79.0% conversion) and long mean completion times (514s).)
3: [home, redesign] Waiting Spotlight Tip Carousel: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight layout displaying an automated carousel of desktop usage tips while pet assets prepare. (why: Median wait time in home stage is high (201s / mean 2336s) causing user drop-off before pet launch.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Reassurance Banner: Display a prominent reassurance hint on the sign-in screen confirming existing pets will restore automatically. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Spotlight Layout: Switch the choose path screen layout to spotlight, clearly emphasizing fast friend adoption versus custom pet creation. (why: Initial path choice conversion is low (79.0%) with high mean duration (514s).)
6: [adoption, hint] Pet Adoption Account Link Verification Hint: Add an explicit confirmation hint on the adoption certificate screen assuring users their pet is saved to their account. (why: Reduces user anxiety regarding pet loss and accounts resetting prior to finalizing onboarding.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Completion Timer Display: Enable progress bar, time estimate indicator, and notification alerts on the waiting screen. (why: Home phase median duration is 201s (mean 2336s); setting clear time expectations prevents abandonment.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Summoning Tip Callout: Add a prominent system tray control tip on the home intro welcome screen. (why: Support complaints highlight confusion regarding how to locate and control the pet once onboarding ends.)
